input: Research standing desks for under two hundred dollars

gold.taskTitle: Research Standing Desks for Under Two Hundred Dollars
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify suitable standing desks available for purchase under $200.

questions.title: Do you want a fixed or height-adjustable standing desk?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs a desk that stays at standing height only or one that can be raised and lowered.

questions.title: What size desktop surface do you need?
questions.description: Clarify the required width and depth of the desk surface to fit the user's workspace and equipment.

questions.title: Where exactly will this desk be placed?
questions.description: Understand the physical location, such as a home office, bedroom, or corporate workspace, to account for space constraints.

questions.title: What equipment will sit on the desk?
questions.description: Find out what the user plans to place on the desk, such as monitors, a laptop, or other peripherals, to assess weight and space needs.

questions.title: Do you prefer a specific material or color finish?
questions.description: Identify any aesthetic preferences such as wood grain, black, white, or metal finishes to narrow down options.

questions.title: Is assembly difficulty a concern for you?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants something easy to assemble solo or is comfortable with more complex builds.

questions.title: Where do you plan to buy it, online or in-store?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred shopping channel to focus research on the right retailers and availability.
